label: 几何指标（量化评估 + 评分）
description: 对 Geometry 做量化评估并给综合健康分：基本信息（parts/joints/DOF、整体 bbox 尺寸与 footprint 面积、rich vs primitive、arch/csg 计数）+ 质量指标（兄弟 part 重叠对数/体积/最大穿深/占比、可动关节休止位互穿、连通分量/悬空件/joint 缝隙、着地 min_z、丰富度、面数预算）。输出多行 report、0–100 综合 score 与分级 grade，以及各标量端口。与 g_geometry_qc 互补：QC 出布尔信号，g_metrics 出量化数值 + 评分。只读分析，不改 Geometry。
description-en: Quantitative evaluation with an overall health score. Basic info (parts/joints/DOF, overall bbox size and footprint area, rich vs primitive, arch/csg counts) plus quality metrics (sibling AABB overlap pairs/volume/max penetration/ratio, moving-joint rest-pose interpenetration, connected components/floating links/joint gaps, grounding min_z, richness, poly budget). Emits a multiline report, a 0–100 score, a grade, and scalar ports. Complements g_geometry_qc: QC emits boolean signals, g_metrics emits quantities + a score. Read-only.

inputs.name: bake
inputs.label: 烘焙面数
inputs.description: 是否计入面数预算指标（静态电池内无 baker，当前仅置位提示）
inputs.description-en: Whether to include poly-budget metrics (no baker in-battery; currently a hint only).

inputs.name: overlap_tol
inputs.label: 重叠容差 (m)
inputs.description: 兄弟 part AABB 三轴最小重叠深度都超过该值才算重叠
inputs.description-en: Minimum per-axis overlap depth to count as interpenetration.

inputs.name: gap_tol
inputs.label: 缝隙/着地容差 (m)
inputs.description: 已连接父子件间距 / 整体离地超过该值才计缝隙 / 离地
inputs.description-en: Connected parent-child gap / ground offset threshold.

inputs.name: tri_budget
inputs.label: 面数预算
inputs.description: 低模面数预算；0=不设预算（需 bake=true 才评估）
inputs.description-en: Triangle budget for low-poly; 0 = none (needs bake=true).

inputs.name: precision
inputs.label: 报告小数位
inputs.description: report 里数值的小数位数
inputs.description-en: Decimal places for numbers in the report.

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.label: 几何
outputs.description: 原样透传，便于继续接下游
outputs.description-en: Passthrough geometry for downstream piping.

outputs.name: report
outputs.label: 报告
outputs.description: 多行人类可读评估报告（基本信息 + 各质量项 pass/warn/fail 明细 + 综合分）
outputs.description-en: Multiline human-readable evaluation report.

outputs.name: score
outputs.label: 综合分
outputs.description: 0–100 综合健康分
outputs.description-en: 0–100 overall health score.

outputs.name: grade
outputs.label: 分级
outputs.description: A–F 分级
outputs.description-en: A–F grade.

outputs.name: overlap_pairs
outputs.label: 重叠对数
outputs.description: rest pose 下相互重叠的兄弟 part 对数
outputs.description-en: Sibling part AABB overlap pairs.

outputs.name: overlap_volume
outputs.label: 重叠体积 (m³)
outputs.description: 各重叠盒体积求和
outputs.description-en: Sum of overlap box volumes.

outputs.name: max_penetration
outputs.label: 最大穿深 (m)
outputs.description: 各重叠对最小轴穿深的最大值
outputs.description-en: Max min-axis penetration depth over overlapping pairs.

outputs.name: overlap_ratio
outputs.label: 重叠占比
outputs.description: 重叠体积 / 整体包围盒体积
outputs.description-en: Overlap volume / overall bounding volume.

outputs.name: moving_joint_collisions
outputs.label: 可动关节碰撞数
outputs.description: 可动关节（revolute/prismatic/...）父子件在休止位互穿的对数（真实缺陷）
outputs.description-en: Moving-joint parent-child pairs interpenetrating at rest (real defect).

outputs.name: islands
outputs.label: 连通分量数
outputs.description: part 通过 joint 形成的连通分量数；>1 表示有孤岛
outputs.description-en: Connected components among parts via joints.

outputs.name: floating_links
outputs.label: 悬空件数
outputs.description: 无关节路径到根树的 part 数（运行时被 URDF 丢弃）
outputs.description-en: Parts with no joint path to the root tree.

outputs.name: joints_with_gap
outputs.label: 缝隙关节数
outputs.description: 已连接父子件 AABB 间距超过 gap_tol 的 joint 数
outputs.description-en: Joints whose connected parts sit farther than gap_tol apart.

outputs.name: max_joint_gap
outputs.label: 最大关节缝隙 (m)
outputs.description: 已连接父子件的最大 AABB 间距
outputs.description-en: Max AABB gap over connected parent-child pairs.

outputs.name: ground_offset
outputs.label: 着地偏移 (m)
outputs.description: 整体最小 Z（≈0 贴地；<0 陷入；>0 悬空）
outputs.description-en: Overall min Z (≈0 grounded; <0 sunk; >0 floating).

outputs.name: dof
outputs.label: 自由度
outputs.description: 可动关节自由度总和（revolute/prismatic=1、planar=2、floating=6）
outputs.description-en: Total DOF of moving joints.

outputs.name: primitive_only
outputs.label: 仅裸 primitive
outputs.description: 模型是否全为裸 primitive（无任何富几何）
outputs.description-en: Whether the model is entirely bare primitives.

outputs.name: primitive_ratio
outputs.label: 裸 primitive 占比
outputs.description: shape 语句中裸 primitive 的比例（0–1）
outputs.description-en: Ratio of bare primitives among shape statements (0–1).

outputs.name: tri_count
outputs.label: 三角面数
outputs.description: 烘焙后三角面数（需 bake；静态电池暂为 0）
outputs.description-en: Baked triangle count (needs baker; 0 in static battery).

outputs.name: vertex_count
outputs.label: 顶点数
outputs.description: 烘焙后顶点数（需 bake；静态电池暂为 0）
outputs.description-en: Baked vertex count (needs baker; 0 in static battery).

outputs.name: over_budget
outputs.label: 超预算
outputs.description: tri_count 是否超过 tri_budget
outputs.description-en: Whether tri_count exceeds tri_budget.
